item.title: Pulaski Co. fiber-optic network lines vandalized, causes internet service outage
item.description: Optimum in Cabot is restoring internet service after fiber-optic lines were vandalized, and repairs are underway with a report filed with the Pulaski County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Benton officials give first look into under-construction Buc-ee’s
item.description: Buc-ee's is constructing a 74,000 square foot retail space with 120 gas pumps and 200 jobs at the Highway 229 intersection off Interstate 30 Exit 114 in Benton, Arkansas, and is expected to open in September.

item.title: Arkansas Supreme Court ruling allows candidate to remain in House race in hot check controversy
item.description: The Arkansas Supreme Court ruled that Laura "Missy" Michelle Wardlaw, a Republican candidate for Arkansas House District 94, is eligible to remain in the race despite her 2018 violation of the Arkansas Hot Check Law, as the court found that she did not enter a guilty plea, appear in court, or be found guilty by a court.

item.title: Little Rock jury finds three men guilty of multi-state cocaine and methamphetamine distribution
item.description: Three men, Bruce McArthur Smith, Kevin Langel, and Larry Rogers, were found guilty in a drug distribution scheme that ran from California to Arkansas, and will be sentenced later.

item.title: Little Rock gym members celebrate birthday of 96-year-old after she creates strong friendship through swimming
item.description: Aniko Diamant was turning 96 years old, and one of her closest friends, 78 year old Roger Yancey, decided to throw her a surprise party at one of her most favorite places, Genesis Health Clubs.

item.title: Crews find 3 pipe bombs while cleaning storm drains in Cave Springs
item.description: The Cave Springs Police Department confirmed three pipe bombs were found inside storm drains at the intersection of Torrence Drive and Rainbow Road on Wednesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: Cleanup underway for Saline County arena collapse
item.description: Cleanup crews are making steady progress at the Saline County Fairgrounds after the January 27 collapse of the main rodeo arena roof, as county leaders and fair officials begin planning how to rebuild the longtime community hub.

item.title: Estée Lauder sues Walmart over alleged 'despicable' sale of counterfeit fragrances
item.description: Cosmetic company Estée Lauder has filed a lawsuit in federal court against Bentonville-based Walmart, accusing the retailer of selling counterfeits of its fragrances along with other brands.

item.title: Family pleads for answers as North Little Rock man remains missing since September of 2025
item.description: A North Little Rock family is pleading for answers as police continue searching for a man who has been missing for months.
